limitationTriage.limitation: Stability at r = 8 (degenerate normal Hessian at the cone point) is undetermined.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a higher-order energy expansion along the two extra zero normal modes settle local minimality?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exact spectrum computed (7 zeros); Lemma 4 does not apply; no known theorem covers it.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Needs a new fourth-order analysis; stated as open in Remark 12.

limitationTriage.limitation: No minimal vertex count is claimed.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a smaller positive unweighted graph with a stable non-manifold continuum?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: 36-vertex weighted version given (Remark 16); exhaustive search not attempted.

limitationTriage.limitation: Whether a smaller non-complete base graph such as K_{3,3} already violates the closed reading is undetermined.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the equilibrium set of K_{3,3} admit a closed cover?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Sclosa's analysis of K_{3,3} read; not resolved.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Requires new local analysis of K_{3,3} singularities.

limitationTriage.limitation: All phenomena sit at exact resonances and are not robust to generic perturbation.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is non-robustness a genuine feature rather than a gap?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Stratification and transversality: generic weights admit no equal-sum partition, so B_a is smooth (Section 7.1).

limitationTriage.limitation: The literal arXiv v1 reading of the conjecture is not refuted.
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Yes: stratification of compact real algebraic sets (Bochnak-Coste-Roy).

limitationTriage.limitation: Coupled-cell priority checked only at the level of main definitions and theorems.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a coupled-cell, graph-covering or signed-lift theorem already give the full realisation with germ and stability transfer?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: SGP, GST, GS main results; neighbouring literatures named by the correctness review.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Exhaustive priority search is beyond a bounded release check; the claim is stated conditionally.

limitationTriage.limitation: Extension to the Kuramoto-Sakaguchi model and noise robustness not studied.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the realisation survive a phase lag?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Not attempted; the sine identity sin(x+pi) = -sin x used in invariance holds with phase lag, but gradient structure is lost.
